reason: This report documents UPDATES to the municipal-waste-incineration MODEL, not the datasets it produces: DeNOx technology mix (Tab. 2.2), ancillary material input during average MSWI operation (Tab. 2.3), internal energy demand (Tab. 2.5, Tab. 2.6), transfer coefficients (Tab. 6.1, Tab. 6.2, Fig. 6.1), average waste composition (Tab. 6.3) and measurement-report emissions in mg per Nm3 of flue gas (Tab. 6.4). Nothing is specific to digester sludge and no table gives the exchanges of one waste-specific incineration dataset per kg of waste, so the inventory of 'Disposal, digester sludge, to municipal incineration' is not locatable here.
